title: The Benefit a Travel Protection Plans Certificate Records as Consumed
content:
The benefit a Travel Protection Plans certificate records as consumed, when a settlement is rated on it, is read from the payments settled on that certificate in this policy term, the amounts restored to it from a liable third party, and the benefit account the certificate itself carries.

Where the certificate carries a payment settled in this policy term and it carries an amount restored from a liable third party, the benefit the certificate records as consumed is the payments it has settled less the amounts restored.

Where the certificate carries a payment settled in this policy term and it carries no amount restored, the benefit the certificate records as consumed is the payments it has settled.

Where neither holds, the benefit the certificate records as consumed is the figure its benefit account carries.

## The three readings

| Payments settled in this policy term | Amounts restored from a liable third party | The benefit recorded as consumed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Above nothing | Some amount restored | The payments settled, less the amounts restored |
| Above nothing | None | The payments settled |
| None | Either way | The figure the certificate's benefit account carries |

## Reading the record

The first two readings both require a payment settled in this policy term to stand on the certificate; they are told apart by whether any amount has been restored to it from a liable third party. A restoration lowers the figure, because what was taken from the benefit and has since come back is no longer consumed.

The third reading is reached whenever no payment has been settled in this policy term, and it rests on the benefit account the certificate carries rather than on the claim record.

Hypothetically, a certificate on which 1200.00 USD has been settled in this term and 300.00 USD restored records 900.00 USD as consumed. The same certificate with nothing restored records 1200.00 USD as consumed. A certificate with no payment settled in this term records whatever its benefit account carries, which might be 0.00 USD or some other figure entirely.
